name: rules-rtdb-r10-type-guards
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r10-type-guards" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). the snapshot type guards decide a real profile write: a stringly-typed age, a stringly-typed active flag, an empty name and a reserved internal child must each deny, and the locked-profile lock must hold — production and the simulator must agree guard for guard.
